snippet.title: Beavertale Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The official release of Beavertale!

store.steampowered.com/app/4568350/Beavertale

An adventure about a beaver trying to recover his home from an evil corporation, using his natural beaver construction abilities.

Join Gus on this adventure through the forest.

Release date: May 28, 2026.

Wishlist now on Steam!
